en.headline: Organisers cancel final leisure group of Victoria Harbour Swim over strong currents
en.dek: The Hong Kong China Swimming Association said about 700 swimmers in the last leisure group did not enter the water and would receive refunds.
body: The final group of the leisure category in the Victoria Harbour Swim 2026 was cancelled on Sunday morning because of strong currents, the organising Hong Kong China Swimming Association said.

Association president Wong Min-chiu said the decision was made for safety reasons and because of time limits on the venue. About 700 participants in the fourth leisure group did not enter the water and would have their entry fees refunded. The association would consider giving them priority next year if they still qualified.

The event, which has about 4,000 places, started from the public pier at Golden Bauhinia Square in Wan Chai and finished at the Avenue of Stars in Tsim Sha Tsui. Some swimmers who had already entered the water reported being pushed far off course by the current, with some reaching near the Star Ferry pier.
The association said it would continue to monitor remaining swimmers in the water and was confident they could reach shore safely. Earlier groups and the competitive category proceeded.
Some participants who had waited without entering the water expressed disappointment, while others who were recalled after a short swim said they understood the safety decision.

zh.headline: 維港泳優悠組最後一組因水流太急取消 約700人受影響
zh.dek: 中國香港游泳總會表示，最後一組優悠組約700名泳手未有落水，將退還報名費。
body: 中國香港游泳總會表示，維港泳2026周日早上因水流太急，取消優悠組最後一組賽事。
泳總會長王敏超指出，基於安全及交還場地的時間限制作出決定。第四組約700名泳手最終無落水，將退回報名費，並考慮明年讓符合資格者優先參與。
賽事由灣仔金紫荊廣場公眾碼頭出發，終點為尖沙咀星光大道，全程約一公里。部分已落水泳手表示被水流沖離航道，最遠有人接近天星碼頭。
泳總表示會繼續監察仍在海面的泳手，有信心他們可安全上岸。較早組別及競賽組照常進行。
部分未落水的參加者表示失望，有短暫落水後被召回的泳手則表示理解安全決定。
